title: Download Spatial Datasets of Peru
text: geoperu package provides convenient interface access official spatial datasets Peru directly R. data collected National Institute Statistics Informatics (INEI) Peru.

title: Download Spatial Datasets of Peru
text: Install released version geoperu CRAN: Install development version GitHub pak: access spatial information districts province Peru, can use get_geo_peru() function. visualize retrieved geospatial information get_geo_peru() function geoperu package, can use various tools R. common option use ggplot2 library along sf object visualization functionality. ’s basic example visualize data: geoperu also provides access spatial information natural protected areas Peru. areas, managed declared National Service Natural Areas Protected State (SERNANP), encompass diverse range ecosystems. get_anp_peru() function allows users download spatial data representing protected areas directly R environment. can customize plot adding additional layers, adjusting styles, adding labels according specific needs.
code: install.packages("geoperu") pak::pak("PaulESantos/geoperu") library(geoperu)  cusco <- geoperu::get_geo_peru(geography = "CUSCO",                                    level = "dep",                                   simplified = FALSE) cusco cusco_simplified <- geoperu::get_geo_peru(geography = "CUSCO",                                    level = "dep",                                   simplified = TRUE) cusco_simplified  prov_sf <- geoperu::get_geo_peru(geography = "ANTA",                                  level = "prov",                                   simplified = TRUE) prov_sf islay_sf <- geoperu::get_geo_peru(geography = "ISLAY",                                  level = "prov",                                   simplified = FALSE) islay_sf library(patchwork) library(ggplot2) plot1 <- cusco |>    ggplot() +   geom_sf() +   theme_bw()  plot2 <- cusco_simplified |>    ggplot() +   geom_sf() +   theme_bw()  plot1 + plot2 manu <- get_anp_peru(anp = "manu") manu  manu |>    ggplot() +   geom_sf() +   theme_bw()

title: Download Spatial Data of Protected Natural Areas (ANP) in Peru — get_anp_peru
text: Downloads spatial data protected natural areas Peru declared SERNANP (National Service Natural Areas Protected State). Data obtained GEO ANP official source. data use WGS 84 (EPSG:4326).

title: Download spatial data of Peru — get_geo_peru
text: Downloads spatial data Peru using WGS 84 geodetic reference system (EPSG:4326).

title: Download spatial data of Peru — get_geo_peru
code: get_geo_peru(   geography = "all",   level = "all",   simplified = TRUE,   showProgress = TRUE )

title: Download spatial data of Peru — get_geo_peru
text: geography character vector name geographical region. exception "" request Peru data. level character: "" national level data, "dep" department level data, "prov" provincial level data. simplified logical TRUE FALSE, select data districts polygon simplified higher level. showProgress Logical TRUE FALSE display progress bar download.

title: geoperu 0.0.1
text: Made downloads atomic validated HTTP responses caching files. Improved error messages unavailable, empty, malformed remote data. Removed duplicate network requests consolidated GeoPackage downloads. Added argument validation expanded automated tests. Updated documentation CRAN metadata.
